sn2.23:1.1: The name _serī_ here is from _siri_ (“auspiciousness, good luck”). He does not appear elsewhere.
sn2.23:8.1: The moral of this story is echoed in [sn3.18:9.1]().
sn2.23:8.2: Sharing wealth is a moral act. | _Dīyittha_ is passive reflexive aorist of √_dā_.
sn2.23:8.10: “Dwindled” is _paṭikkami_, literally “went backwards”. This sense is also recorded for Sanskrit _pratikram_.
